copy.dek: @jonraduazzo got a monster game from Josh Allen and still lost, because Jake Ferguson watched from the bench.
copy.hero_caption: One-man band, still lost the gig.
story: Josh Allen did everything but play tight end, which is exactly where @jonraduazzo lost. Jake Ferguson scored twice from the bench while Dallas Goedert started and caught one ball. Allen built the house; the tight end left the door open.
Four-touchdown quarterbacks were so common this week that two of them sat on benches. @naaaaaaaaaaaaaaaate picked Goff over Dak by two hundredths. Genius is a rounding error.
@louisnicoletti has outscored three teams that already have a win, and still has none. The schedule is the one defender JSN can't beat.
A week after @casebrabham blew out @cdb1919, they traded places: @cdb1919 posted the top score and @casebrabham got blown out. Karma in this league runs on a one-week delay.

.pr-team b { display: block; font-size: clamp(.75rem, calc(100cqi / (var(--n) + .2)), 1.25rem); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: .01em; color: var(--chalk); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

/* Trophies: the supporting stats package. Every winner gets a lower third. */
.aws { display: grid; gap: 14px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }

/* Other fun stats: one stat sheet, rows split by hairlines, the headshot down the left. */

}

.fold summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; background: var(--ink-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--chalk); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.fold summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.fold summary::before { content: "+"; color: var(--volt); font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; }
.fold[open] summary::before { content: "–"; }

/* ---------- The show open: one orchestrated load sequence (skipped for reduced motion) ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .cue:not(.roll) :is(.mast-in, .kick, .headline, .dek, .stat, .crawl) { opacity: 0; }
  .roll .mast-in { animation: drop .5s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1) both; }
  .roll .kick { animation: wipe .45s .15s cubic-bezier(.7, 0, .2, 1) both; }
  .roll .headline { animation: slam .65s .28s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .25, 1.12) both; }
  .roll .dek { animation: rise .5s .6s ease-out both; }
  .roll .stat { animation: fly .7s .72s cubic-bezier(.15, .85, .25, 1.06) both; }
  .roll .led { animation: power .55s 1.22s linear both; }
  .roll .ring path { stroke-dasharray: 1 1; animation: draw .6s 1.6s cubic-bezier(.55, 0, .35, 1) both; }
  .roll .stat .pen { animation: scrawl .5s 2.05s steps(9, end) backwards; }
  .roll .arrow path { stroke-dasharray: 1 1; animation: draw .3s 2.55s ease-out both; }
  .roll .crawl { animation: rise .5s 2.2s ease-out both; }
  .hold-box { display: block; }
  .hold { display: grid; }
  .crawl-view { overflow: hidden; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 18px, #000 calc(100% - 18px), transparent); }
  .crawl-set + .crawl-set { display: flex; }
